text-to-binary-converter.formula:
encode: for each UTF-8 byte -> 8-bit binary string
decode: clean input -> split into 8-bit groups -> bytes -> UTF-8 text
bits = bytes x 8
howTo: Choose Encode (text to binary) or Decode (binary to text).
Type or paste your input into the box.
For encoding, pick a separator: spaces, new lines or none.
Read the result live in the output box.
Copy it or download it as a text file.
keyFacts: Text is encoded as UTF-8 bytes before conversion to binary.
Every byte becomes exactly 8 binary digits.
ASCII letters need 8 bits; emoji need 32 bits.
Decoding accepts spaces, commas and line breaks between groups.
Malformed input shows a specific, friendly error message.
text-to-binary-converter.keywords: text to binary converter, binary to text decoder, binary code translator, string to binary online, binary translator
limitations: This is an encoding, not encryption — anyone can decode it.
Very long inputs produce very long binary strings.
Decoding requires complete 8-bit groups of valid UTF-8.

text-to-binary-converter.quickAnswer: Converts text into binary strings and binary back into text: every UTF-8 byte becomes an 8-bit group. Encode mode offers space, newline or no separators; decode mode ignores spaces and commas and reports clear errors for malformed input. Handles emoji and non-Latin scripts correctly, with bit and character counts plus one-click copy and download.

text-to-binary-converter.workedExample:
Encode "Hi":
H = code 72 -> binary 01001000
 i = code 105 -> binary 01101001
Output (space separator): 01001000 01101001
Bits: 2 bytes x 8 = 16

Decode "01001000 01101001":
Groups: [01001000, 01101001] -> bytes [72, 105] -> UTF-8 text "Hi"
